_contract.name: decision_output
_contract.note: Example values for UI development only. The improvement figure here is an illustration, not a result.

explanation.text: Store A will likely sell only 28 of its 120 yogurts before they expire in 3 days, while Store B, 2.1 km away, is nearly out of stock and sells about 30 a day. Moving 60 units to Store B and marking the remaining 60 down 15% recovers more than any single action, and any leftover goes to rescue.

explanation_local.text: स्टोर A में दही की 120 इकाइयों में से लगभग 28 ही 3 दिन में बिक पाएंगी। स्टोर B में स्टॉक लगभग खत्म है। 60 इकाइयाँ स्टोर B भेजें और बाकी पर 15% छूट दें।

staff_tasks.title: Pack and send 60 yogurts to Store B
steps: Pick the 60 units with the earliest expiry
Hand over to the driver by 09:00
Apply the 15% label to the remaining 60 units

staff_tasks.title: Receive 60 yogurts from Store A
steps: Check the expiry dates on arrival
Shelve at the front of the dairy section
